methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); electric utility signals

pit_profile.why: The Southern Company: 'Southern Company owns all the outstanding common stock of Alabama Power, Georgia Power, Gulf Power and Mississippi Power, each of which is an operating public utility company. The traditional operating companies supply electric service in the states of Alabama, Georgia, Florida and Mississippi.'; among its risk factors, 'Southern Company and its subsidiaries are subject to substantial governmental regulation.', 'The operating results of Southern Company, the traditional operating companies and Southern Power are affected by weather conditions and may fluctuate on a seasonal and quarterly basis.' and 'Existing environmental laws and regulations may be revised or new laws and regulations related to global climate change, air quality or other environmental and health concerns may be adopted or become applicable to Southern Company, the traditional operating companies and Southern Power.' (its own FY2006 10-K); no disruption theme in the registry is live for an electric utility on this date, so the watch list is empty and the 10-K's words on climate change legislation stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

BEAR.desc: EPS -5.7%/yr (worst year FY97-FY06, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +5.2%/yr (Q3 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +5.2%/yr (FY97-FY06 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +12.3%/yr (best 2-yr run FY97-FY06); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: SO (retrospective, 2008-01-11) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 6.14x (34.6% downside to Bear $26 / +5.6% upside to Bull $42) | Adj composite 2.36 vs market 3.80: gap -1.44 [OVERVALUED] | +35% above the EPP floor $29 (14x FY07E $2.10) | Conservative 2-yr case: -1.6% total (-0.8%/yr) | At 18.9x FY07E the 15% hurdle price $53 sits above the BULL case; retail kWh sales +1.2% in Q3 2007, forward revenues +6.2% (no Q4 2007 revenue guide, Q3 2007 revenue as reported); no disruption theme is live for an electric utility on this date.
